snippet.title: LONESTAR 1.0 is Out Now!
snippet.description:
LONESTAR 1.0 is now available on Steam on Steam, Epic Games Store, and Nintendo Switch. Get it at 15% off during the launch period:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2056210/LONESTAR/
https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/lonestar-switch/
https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/lonestar-83f143

LONESTAR is a turn-based roguelike strategy game with deckbuilding elements, where you customize a starship using mathematical components and engage in tactical duels.

After a successful Early Access journey, this major update takes the roguelike deckbuilding experience to the next level with new gameplay mechanics, expanded content, and formidable challenges.

What’s New in Version 1.0： 
- New Spaceship – Spectra: Joining the original two ships, the brand-new Spectra is here! Choose from three distinct spaceships and embark on unique interstellar journeys.

- Major Component Upgrade: The early access version already featured over 170 components, and now we’re adding 85 more, giving you an expanded arsenal of customization options.

- Expanded Pilot Roster: With the addition of 13 pilots during EA, the full release brings the total to over 50 pilots, each with unique skills and compelling backstories.

- Increased Random Events: The number of random events has more than doubled to 130+, making every adventure unpredictable and thrilling.

- New Boss Encounters: Each stage now features a brand-new boss. Get ready to face even tougher foes!

- Hidden Boss Unlocks: The legendary hidden boss has been added to the Elite Hunter’s Menu—a challenge reserved for only the most skilled bounty hunters.

- Integrated Workshop: Unleash your creativity in the LONESTAR universe with full Workshop support.

- Steam Deck Support: Play LONESTAR anytime, anywhere with full Steam Deck compatibility! Whether you're walking, commuting, or winding down, your adventure is always within reach.

- Nintendo Switch Version: Version 1.0 will also launch on Nintendo Switch, bringing the cosmic adventure to handheld gamers.

- Multilingual Support: We’ve added Traditional Chinese and Japanese, making LONESTAR accessible to even more bounty hunters worldwide.

- Special Crossovers and Exclusive Bundles: Exciting crossovers with Backpack Battles, Magicraft, and Chrono Ark on April 3rd, featuring crossover pilots and exclusive bundles!

#indiegame #gaming #steamgames #roguelike  #deckbuilder
